name: Sae
source:
Sae, a girl seemingly unaffected by her surroundings, lives life with the philosophy that the best reaction is a subdued one.

Or at least... she tries to.

Easily flustered, her array of talents is almost limitless. Only when she cares to apply herself, that is. As blunt as a hammer, her straightforward nature hits hard - and her words even harder. With so much mystery behind her, she'll throw in the confusion free of charge.
